configuration.status: exploratory on previously examined dates and current-survivor selected securities
configuration.eligibility: 272 complete contiguous prior log returns ending t-1; same admitted stocks across windows/models; no future availability filtering
configuration.signal: one-session vendor-adjusted close-to-close log return at t
configuration.training: prior observations t-lookback:t, exclusive of signal day
configuration.weights: inverse prior total-return variance; daily sigma floor 0.0001
configuration.holdings: minus W times cross-sectional WLS residual, normalized to unit gross; no caps
configuration.exposures: SPY_only: dollars+SPY beta; PCA3/PCA10: additional raw-return-scaled residual PCs; sectors/average: 11 group indicators+SPY beta
configuration.pca_scaling: standardize prior SPY residual histories; raw exposure basis = residual_sigma[:,None] * right_singular_vectors
configuration.primary_execution: next vendor raw daily-bar open to same session raw close; ideal fractional-dollar targets, flat nightly
configuration.horizon_response: 1/5/20-session cumulative all-adjusted next-open-to-exit-close returns of frozen initial sleeves; common complete 20-session dates, omit split-crossing events; not a funded overlapping-cohort strategy
configuration.horizon_slope: pooled e'W R / e'W e; equivalent to future formation-exposure residual/sigma on signal residual/sigma; negative indicates reversal
configuration.universe_control: rerun original30 SPY_only and PCA3 on identical dates/windows; groups/PCA10 comparators only expanded200
configuration.split: entry before 2024-01-01 development, otherwise later; not untouched holdout
configuration.descriptive_PCA: 2016-2023 only, balance using availability in that period only; original30 and expanded200; standardized raw log returns; full-panel membership is not used for backtest admission
configuration.uncertainty: 1000 circular moving-block resamples of 60 formation dates per period; pointwise approximate 95%; paired broad-minus-original control uses identical resamples
configuration.reported_selection: all declared models/windows/periods; no winning setting selected
configuration.state_features: save past-fit mean residual correlation, residual PC1 share, H0 death quantiles, prior SPY volatility as potential regime inputs; no state-to-profit model fitted
configuration.representation_snapshot: formation 2023-12-29, prior 252 sessions, current admitted stocks; stock residual-history geometry, full weighted loadings identity control, top3 weighted loading geometry, and day points in top3 factor-score space
configuration.snapshot_scaling: each non-control distance matrix divided by its own positive median pair distance for diagram comparison; raw scale saved separately
configuration.persistence: snapshot H0/H1 Vietoris-Rips, finite intervals saved; no interpretation as economic cycles, significance, calendar duration, or profitable regimes
